events.posterAlt: Poster for Wednesday 4 November 2026 at Keystone Crescent Members Club, King's Cross, N1 9DX: Connection Workshop with Hoi, 7:30–9pm, where international Brazilian Zouk dancer Hoi Ung explores the fundamentals of partner connection; Open Level Bachata Class with Zach, 7:30–9pm, for people from 0 to 1 year experience and absolute beginners, class £10 + booking fee; Free Social, 9pm till late.

feature.headline: Connection workshop
feature.lede: This Wednesday only, at Keystone Crescent, King's Cross. 7:30–9pm, then the free social from 9pm. An Open Level Bachata class with Zach runs alongside it, 7:30–9pm.

schedule.title: Connection workshop
